DURING  THE WEEK OF MAY 6TH, THE MAJORITY OF SOILS IMPACTED  BY THE RELEASE WERE EXCAVATED AND TEMPORARILY STORED ONSITE AWAITING DISPOSAL.
TO PREVENT REOCCURRENCE, ET WILL CONTINUE TO RAISE AWARENESS ON THE IMPORTANCE OF MAKING A ONE-CALL NOTIFICATION PRIOR TO EXCAVATION.
